review_text: The margherita had a thin crisp crust, fresh basil, and balanced tomato sauce. I would order it again.
Good cheese and quick service, but the crust was soft in the middle and the pizza arrived lukewarm.
The pepperoni pizza was flavorful with plenty of toppings. The garlic knots were a little dry.
A small dining room with friendly staff. The vegetarian pizza had fresh vegetables and a nice char.
The tomato sauce tasted too salty and the delivery took almost an hour. The pizza was still warm.
Excellent gluten-free crust, crisp edges, and clearly marked allergen options. A bit expensive.
The mushroom pizza was rich and earthy. I liked the thin crust, though it could use more sauce.
Our order was missing one topping, but the staff fixed it quickly. The pizza tasted fresh.
Great lunch special with a generous slice and a drink. Fast service and a crunchy crust.
The cheese pizza was bland and the crust tasted like it had been reheated. I will not return soon.
The spicy sausage pizza had a good kick and plenty of cheese. The tables needed cleaning.
Nice vegan cheese option and fresh toppings. The pizza was smaller than I expected for the price.
The dough was chewy and flavorful, and the oven char was perfect. The house salad was fresh too.
Delivery was fast, but the box was crushed and the toppings had slid to one side.
A lovely family dinner. The four-cheese pizza was creamy without being too heavy.
The crust was tough and there was very little sauce. The cashier was polite and helpful.
The barbecue chicken pizza was smoky and satisfying. I would like a few more vegetarian choices.
The restaurant was crowded, but our order came out hot. The pepperoni was crisp and not greasy.
Affordable prices and good portions. The crust was soft, which I enjoy, and the service was welcoming.
The pizza was cold when it arrived, and customer support did not respond to my message.
The pesto chicken pizza had bright pesto flavor and a crisp base. Parking nearby was difficult.
The lunch buffet had several fresh options, but the vegetarian pizza ran out before noon.
The best part was the fluffy garlic bread. The plain cheese pizza was fine but not memorable.
Staff handled my allergy question carefully and explained the ingredients. The pizza was delicious.
